brand.name: Villa Devonté
brand.description: Villa Devonté is a premium hospitality destination offering luxury rooms, an elegant restaurant, a warm lounge and a private hot tub experience — all a single WhatsApp message away.
brand.story: Villa Devonté began as a family home built around a courtyard, a long dining table and an open sky. Today it welcomes guests from across the world, but the spirit has never changed: generous hospitality, quiet luxury and food made to be shared.
brand.philosophy: We believe luxury should feel effortless. No queues, no forms, no accounts — just a conversation. Tell us what you need and our team makes it happen.

restaurant.intro: Our kitchen pairs the bold, smoky flavours of West African cooking with the precision of a modern continental kitchen. Everything is prepared to order, plated simply and served in a room designed to slow you down.
points: Indoor dining room and open-air terrace
Chef's tasting menu available on request
Full bar with signature cocktails and wines
Room service available to all guests

lounge.intro: Low light, warm wood and a soundtrack that never rushes you. The Devonté Lounge is where evenings begin and end — signature cocktails, small plates and live sets on selected nights.

hotTub.intro: A private, heated outdoor tub tucked into the gardens — steam rising under open sky, robes waiting and nowhere else to be. Available by session, day or night.

sessions.name: Couples Sunset Session
sessions.includes: Private tub, sparkling wine, fruit platter

sessions.name: Private Group Session
sessions.includes: Up to 6 guests, attendant, grazing platters

rules: Sessions must be booked in advance
No glassware in or around the tub
Not recommended during pregnancy or for guests with heart conditions

rooms.name: The Devonté Suite
rooms.short: Our signature suite with a private balcony overlooking the gardens.
rooms.desc: The Devonté Suite is the finest room in the villa. Floor-to-ceiling doors open onto a private balcony with garden views, while the interior pairs warm timber, natural linen and soft lighting. A deep soaking tub and rain shower complete the bathroom, and a complimentary hot tub session is included with every stay.

rooms.name: Garden Villa Room
rooms.short: Ground-floor room opening directly onto the courtyard garden.
rooms.desc: Wake up, step out, and you are in the garden. The Garden Villa Room opens onto the courtyard through wide sliding doors, with a private seating area shaded by palms. Ideal for guests who want the outdoors within reach.

rooms.name: Executive King
rooms.short: A generous work-and-rest room with a dedicated study nook.
rooms.desc: Designed for longer stays, the Executive King balances a spacious sleeping area with a dedicated desk and lounge chair. Blackout curtains and acoustic glazing keep the room quiet at any hour.

rooms.name: Classic Queen
rooms.short: Warm, simple and beautifully finished — our essential room.
rooms.desc: The Classic Queen holds everything you need and nothing you don't. Natural textures, soft lighting and a supremely comfortable bed make this the room our returning guests ask for by name.

rooms.name: Terrace Twin
rooms.short: Flexible twin room with a private terrace — perfect for friends.
rooms.desc: Two full-size beds plus a daybed make the Terrace Twin ideal for friends or small families. A private terrace with seating extends the room outdoors, and the bathroom features a double vanity.

events.title: Devonté Sunset Session
events.short: Live DJ, signature cocktails and the best sunset view in the city.
events.desc: Our monthly Sunset Session returns to the rooftop. Expect a live DJ set from 6pm, our full signature cocktail list, and a small-plates menu served until late. Tables are limited and are released two weeks before each date.
events.dressCode: Smart casual — no sportswear or slippers

events.title: Full Moon Hot Tub Night
events.short: A private evening of warm water, candlelight and a curated soundtrack.
events.desc: On the night of the full moon, the garden becomes the venue. The hot tub is dressed with candles, the music is slow, and guests rotate through timed sessions. Light bites and warm drinks are served all evening.
highlights: Warm drinks and light bites included

events.title: Sunday Jazz Brunch
events.short: A live jazz trio, a long table and an unhurried afternoon.
events.desc: Every first Sunday, our restaurant hosts a live jazz trio alongside an unlimited brunch service. Expect seasonal plates, a carving station, a dessert table and bottomless mimosas.

events.title: New Year's Eve Gold Gala
events.short: Black tie, live band, midnight fireworks — our biggest night yet.
events.desc: A sold-out evening of live music, a five-course tasting menu and a midnight fireworks display over the gardens. Thank you to everyone who joined us.

events.title: Devonté Wine & Dine
events.short: A six-course pairing dinner with a guest sommelier.
events.desc: An intimate evening of six courses paired with six wines, hosted by a guest sommelier. Every seat was filled within a week.

events.title: Afrobeat Live Night
events.short: Live band, full dance floor and a very late finish.
events.desc: Our first live Afrobeat night in the lounge — a full band, a packed floor and a finish well past midnight. We will be doing it again soon.
